_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Preservation and Packing Data
summary: This DID specifies the required data and format of preservation and packaging data submitted by contractors for parts and equipment in accordance with DD Form 2326 and MIL-STD-2073-1.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) specifies the required data and format of packaging data to be submitted for parts and equipment packaged by the contractor.
This DID identifies the format and content preparation instructions for preservation and packing data resulting from the work task described by 4.1 of MIL-STD-2073-1. The data must be prepared for common, selective, and special group items defined in MIL-STD-2073-1.
This DID is applicable whenever packaging data specified by appendix E of MIL-STD-2073-1 is submitted by contractors to the DoD contracting activity (packaging organization).
When packaging data is being generated by DI-SESS-81758, do not use DI-PACK-80120. When a Special Packaging Instruction (SPI) is required, the instruction shall be prepared in accordance with DI-PACK-80121C, in addition to submitting information specified in this DID for special group items.
This DID supersedes DI-PACK-80120C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be specified in the contract.

children.title: Preservation and packaging data, DD Form 2326.
children.content: Format shall be in accordance with DD Form 2326 and shall be completed as specified in Appendix E of MIL-STD-2073-1. Coding shall be in accordance with Appendix J of MIL-STD-2073-1.
